extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners seeking reinstatement before the USPTO (petitioners and counsel)
extracted.subtask_short: petition for reinstatement to PTO practice
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and filing a petition for reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office, supported by an affidavit under the governing regulation and subject to the Director's review and decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: The Petition for Reinstatement included an Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A petition for reinstatement should be accompanied by an affidavit meeting the requirements of 37 C.F.R. § 11.58; the affidavit is a required supporting document that the Office will consider when evaluating a reinstatement petition (the sample here shows a petition dated February 28, 2017 with such an affidavit).

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's careful review and discretionary determination
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition and supporting affidavit, the Director of Enrollment and Discipline determines whether reinstatement to practice before the USPTO is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement is granted or denied at the Director's discretion following review of the petition and supporting materials; the decision may be memorialized as an order (e.g., 'Petition is hereby GRANTED').
